# STM32H743 Nano FC + 80A 4-in-1 ESC: Power-Stage Loss Model, Thermal Budget, and Bidirectional DShot600 DMA Allocation

## 0. Scope, Assumptions, and a Feasibility Warning

**Architecture.** The STM32H743 is the flight controller. It generates DShot600 and decodes bidirectional eRPM telemetry. The 48 kHz PWM is generated by the ESC MCU (AT32F421 or STM32G071 class, running AM32 or BLHeli_32), not by the H743. The models below follow that split.

**Assumptions.** Change these and re-run the equations; everything is parametric.

| Parameter | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Battery | 6S, V_bus = 25.2 V (worst case, full charge) | |
| Burst current | 80 A **per channel** | Section 4 also covers all four channels simultaneously |
| PWM | 48 kHz, complementary (synchronous rectification), dead time 200 ns | |
| Commutation | 6-step trapezoidal, 2 phases conducting | |
| MOSFET | Representative 40 V, PQFN 3.3×3.3 class | Substitute your datasheet values |
| R_DS(on),25 | 1.6 mΩ @ V_GS = 10 V | α ≈ 0.006 /K, so ≈1.5× at 110 °C |
| Q_gs / Q_gd / Q_g | 6 / 5 / 25 nC | |
| V_plateau | 4.0 V | |
| R_g,int | 1.0 Ω | |
| Q_rr | 30 nC | |
| C_oss,tr | 800 pF | |
| V_SD | 0.8 V | |
| Gate driver | FD6288Q-class, V_drv = 10 V, R_g,ext = 4.7 Ω | |
| PCB | 8-layer, 2 oz inner/outer | |
